turns.text: Sanding is tedious but so satisfying when you see the final product. What kind of wood are you working with for this table?

turns.text: I'm using cherry. It has a really nice grain and a warm tone that I think will look great.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Cherry is a fantastic choice, it ages beautifully. I hope the titration lab goes well today and you have a wonderful, relaxing evening!

turns.speaker: user
